:::{#cor-probability-finitely-additive}
#### Probability measures are finitely additive

Every [probability measure](#def-probability) is [finitely additive](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#def-finite-additivity):
for any [mutually exclusive](#def-mutually-exclusive) events $\dsn{A}$,

$$\Pr(A_1 \cup \cdots \cup A_n) = \sumin \Pr(A_i)$$

:::

::: proof

A probability measure is a measure (@def-probability),
so [measures are finitely additive](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#cor-measure-finitely-additive) applies to it.

:::
